name: codex-antigravity
description: Delegate tasks from Codex to Google Antigravity (Gemini) as an autonomous coding subagent.

interface.shortDescription: Autonomous coding subagent powered by Google Antigravity (Gemini).
interface.longDescription: A local MCP adapter that lets Codex supervise and delegate code editing, branch management, test execution, and monorepo tasks to Antigravity CLI sessions.
defaultPrompt: Check Antigravity status and available models.
Have Antigravity create a branch, write code, and run tests.
Ask Antigravity to audit this repository.
